svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 13 - SHINGLED NOZZLE + SERVO DRIVE

svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
75 % of bore at 0 deg, 105 % from 90 to 140 deg
Press the throat onto the pod exit; fit the unison ring over the throat housing.
Hang 8 flaps alternating master and seal; each seal laps 0.2 mm outboard.
Mount the servo forward of the ring; fit the pull-only slotted link (slot >= full stroke).
Fit the torsion spring and the hard 105 % stop.
Fail-safe: servo unpowered, push the ring to 75 % and release; it returns to 105 % every time.
Never run the nozzle schedule with the EDFs spinning until the gateway fault logic (105 % command, then load-switch trip) is
The nozzle is not yet a placed part in the assembly (coverage gap); the render shows the hover-attitude starboard pod exit.
